title: Timestamped shipment notes
body:
Support wants to leave notes on a shipment and see when each one was written.

Add `add_note(shipment_id, text)` to `parcelo/shipments.py`. It appends a dict `{"text": ..., "at": <time>}` to the shipment's notes, where `at` is the time the note was added, and returns the shipment.

Adding a note to a shipment that does not exist must fail. Empty text must fail too.
